source: Mutopia Project (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/), pieces marked Public Domain

tunes.title: Ode to Joy (Beethoven)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The famous theme in four-part harmony; the top line is the tune. Stepwise and singable: the easiest melody on the list to recognise. Works as a title, a level-clear or an ending. Slow it down for solemn, speed it up for celebration.

tunes.title: Eine kleine Nachtmusik, 1st movement (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.instrument: String Quartet: Violins, Viola, Cello or Double Bass
tunes.note: Fanfare-like opening (a rising arpeggio answered by a falling one) then a lyrical second theme. Elegant and bright; good for a town, a palace or a confident title.

tunes.title: Piano Sonata K.331, theme (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A siciliano-like 6/8 theme in A major: gentle and sweet. A fine hub, village or "a quiet day" tune; also the theme of a set of six variations if you want a game that develops one tune.

tunes.title: Rondo alla Turca (Mozart)
tunes.form: Sonate Opus KV 331 - Rondo Alla Turca
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Fast, bouncy, "Turkish" (the left hand imitates drums). Great for chases, markets, caper levels. The A section is the famous part; the left hand is busy, so the arp voice is thin.

tunes.title: Gigue in G (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A short, dancing gigue with quick contrapuntal lines; compound time. Use for a lively exploration stage.

tunes.title: Austria / Emperor's Hymn (Haydn)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A stately hymn tune (also the German anthem melody). Good for a ceremony, a coronation, a credits roll. Slow and square: easy to loop.

tunes.title: Music for the Royal Fireworks, Réjouissance (Handel)
tunes.form: La Réjouissance des Feux d'Artifice Royaux (Royal Fireworks)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A trumpet-led celebration; bright and brisk. Use for a victory screen or a festival level.

tunes.title: Minuet in E-flat, WoO 82 (Beethoven)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A courtly minuet in 3/4: relaxed, elegant. For a manor, a ballroom or a gentle puzzle.

tunes.title: Minuet in G (Petzold, in Anna Magdalena's notebook, long attributed to J. S. Bach)
tunes.composer: Christian Petzold (c. 1677–1733), long attributed to J. S. Bach
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The best-known beginner minuet. Simple, clear, perfectly suited to four-channel playback. Note: this is the Anna Magdalena Notebook minuet (BWV Anh. 114), now attributed to Christian Petzold; the Mutopia edition is public domain.

tunes.title: Bist du bei mir (BWV 508, attributed to Stölzel)
tunes.composer: Gottfried Heinrich Stölzel (1690–1749), long attributed to J. S. Bach
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A tender slow aria. Good for an ending, a lullaby moment, a loving story beat.

tunes.title: Sheep May Safely Graze (J. S. Bach, from BWV 208)
tunes.form: Schafe Können Sicher Weiden (Sheep Will Safely Graze)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.instrument: Two flutes, soprano, and basso continuo
tunes.note: A serene pastoral in 3/8-like lilt with a gentle flowing bass. Ideal for a farm, a garden, a sleeping village.

tunes.title: Prelude in C major, WTC I (J. S. Bach)
tunes.form: Das Wohltemperierte Clavier I, Praeludium I
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Pure broken chords. There is no melody on top, so the "lead" will be the top note of each chord: a gentle, constantly moving background (great under puzzle or exploration). Use the lead and bass only; skip the arp voice.

tunes.title: Air on the G string (J. S. Bach)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A slow, singing melody over a walking bass. Solemn and beautiful; for an emotional ending or a night scene.

tunes.title: Maple Leaf Rag (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The classic ragtime: a syncopated melody over an oom-pah bass. Ragtime suits platformers, towns and comic scenes. The left hand is a steady alternation of bass and chord, which maps well to bass + arp.

tunes.title: The Easy Winners (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A swaggering ragtime with a lively, hummable first strain.

tunes.title: Elite Syncopations (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Quick, syncopated and bright; the rhythm is the hook.

tunes.title: Peacherine Rag (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A sunny ragtime, a little gentler than Maple Leaf; good for a friendly town.

tunes.title: Pineapple Rag (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Bright and busy ragtime with a quick left hand.

tunes.title: Sun Flower Slow Drag (Joplin, with Scott Hayden)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A "slow drag": relaxed and swaying. A good easy-going town or beach hub.

tunes.title: Solace, a Mexican serenade (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A tender habanera rhythm under a singing melody: gentle, a little wistful. Good for a calm evening scene.

tunes.title: Bethena, a concert waltz (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A sweet-sad waltz; a good emotional stage or ending.

tunes.title: A Breeze from Alabama (Joplin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Cheerful ragtime with a springy step.

tunes.title: The Liberty Bell march (Sousa)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A brisk, bright march. Marches have clear repeating phrases that loop well; good for a parade, a title, or a quick-paced stage.

tunes.title: El Capitan march (Sousa)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A swashbuckling march with a lively trio.

tunes.title: Hands Across the Sea (Sousa)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A proud, stately march; slower and more ceremonial than the others.

tunes.title: King Cotton march (Sousa)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A jaunty march.

tunes.title: The Gladiator march (Sousa)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A driving, heroic march; fits an arena or a "here we go" stage.

tunes.title: Gymnopédie No. 1 (Satie)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Slow waltz with a floating melody over alternating bass and chord. A model of what four channels do well: leave lots of space. Use it quiet and very slow; the lead is sparse.

tunes.title: Gymnopédie No. 2 (Satie)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A gentler sibling of No. 1, in C major. Slow and sparse.

tunes.title: Gymnopédie No. 3 (Satie)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The most melancholy of the three. Very sparse.

tunes.title: Clair de lune (Debussy, Suite bergamasque)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Moonlight itself. The famous melody enters after a short introduction; it is slow and spacious, with soft arpeggios. Debussy died in 1918. For a night, a lake, a quiet emotional moment.

tunes.title: Première arabesque (Debussy)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Flowing broken chords with a graceful melody. A gentle, moving background for exploration.

tunes.title: Träumerei (Schumann, Kinderszenen)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The classic "Dreaming": a long, singing line over soft harmony. Slow and beautiful; very good for an emotional ending.

tunes.title: Of Foreign Lands and Peoples (Schumann, Kinderszenen)
tunes.form: Kinderscenen - Von fremden Ländern und Menschen
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A gentle, curious tune about faraway places: a good "map" or "a journey begins" theme.

tunes.title: Glückes genug (Schumann, Kinderszenen)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: "Happy enough": warm, simple and content.

tunes.title: Wiegenlied / Cradle Song (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A lullaby with a rocking accompaniment. For a bedtime scene or a sleep screen.

tunes.title: Ave Maria (Schubert, Ellens dritter Gesang)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A flowing, serene hymn-like melody over arpeggios. Solemn and calming.

tunes.title: Heidenröslein (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A simple strophic folk-style song: very easy to loop. For a meadow or a village.

tunes.title: Du bist die Ruh (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A slow, tender, serene song.

tunes.title: Auf dem Wasser zu singen (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The accompaniment ripples like water: for a lake, a river or a boat. The 6/8 rocking figure is the point; the melody floats over it.

tunes.title: An die Musik (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A warm, noble song to music itself; a good menu or credits tune.

tunes.title: Die Forelle / The Trout (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A playful tune with a darting piano figure (the trout in the stream). For a stream, a fishing stage, a light-hearted level.

tunes.title: Prelude Op. 28 No. 4 (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Slow and heavy, a sinking left-hand chord pattern under a restrained melody. For a sad scene or a loss.

tunes.title: Prelude Op. 28 No. 20 (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Twelve bars of solemn chords: very short, very strong. A funeral or a moment of silence; loops well because it is short.

tunes.title: Waltz in B minor, Op. 69 No. 2 (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A wistful, elegant waltz.

tunes.title: Minute Waltz, Op. 64 No. 1 (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A quick, sparkling waltz (about a minute, as the nickname says). The opening has a whirling figure; good for a lively comic scene.

tunes.title: Étude Op. 25 No. 1, "Aeolian Harp" (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A constant wash of broken chords with a melody floating on top: shimmering water or wind. Use the lead and bass.

tunes.title: Étude Op. 10 No. 1 (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Rolling arpeggios across the keyboard; an energetic, heroic motion. The lead is the top note of each arpeggio.

tunes.title: Étude Op. 25 No. 2, "The Bees" (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A quick, murmuring figure like bees: fits a busy, light stage.

tunes.title: Waltz Op. 39 No. 15 (Brahms)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A gentle, famous little waltz. A model of a perfect eight-bar melody; sweet and simple.

tunes.title: Intermezzo Op. 118 No. 2 (Brahms)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A tender, autumnal piece with a warm melody.

tunes.title: The Seasons: January, "At the Fireside" (Tchaikovsky)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A cosy, warm tune for a fireside or an indoor winter scene.

tunes.title: The Seasons: February, "Carnival" (Tchaikovsky)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A lively carnival dance.

tunes.title: The Seasons: August, "Harvest" (Tchaikovsky)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A bustling harvest-time piece; fits a farm or a country fair.

tunes.title: Neapolitan Dance (Tchaikovsky, Swan Lake)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A showy dance that starts with a fanfare; good for a fair or a party stage.

tunes.title: Berceuse (Fauré, Dolly Suite)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: New adaptation from Paris: J. Hamelle
tunes.note: A tender lullaby from the Dolly Suite. Very gentle.

tunes.title: Sonata No. 8 "Pathétique", 1st movement, Allegro (Beethoven)
tunes.form: Sonata No. 8 “Pathétique” (1st Movement: Grave, Allegro molto e con brio)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: After a slow, heavy introduction (the Grave, about 10 bars), the Allegro is driving, stormy and minor. This excerpt starts at the Allegro. Excellent boss or dungeon music.

tunes.title: Sonata No. 8 "Pathétique", 2nd movement, Adagio cantabile (Beethoven)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: One of the most beautiful melodies of the period: a long, singing line. For an emotional ending.

tunes.title: Sonata No. 23 "Appassionata", 3rd movement (Beethoven)
tunes.form: Sonata No. 23 “Appassionata” (3rd Movement: Allegro, ma non troppo - Presto)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Relentless, furious sixteenth-note motion. For a final battle or a desperate chase. Very busy: the lead will be dense.

tunes.title: Symphony No. 5 in C minor, piano reduction (Beethoven)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The short-short-short-long "fate" motif is the most recognisable four notes in classical music; the piano reduction carries the whole first movement. Use the motif as a leitmotif for a villain or a doom.

tunes.title: Symphony No. 25 in G minor, 1st movement (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.instrument: Orchestra: Oboes, Horns, Violins, Viola, 'Cello, Bass
tunes.note: The "little G minor": restless, syncopated, urgent. A good boss or pursuit.

tunes.title: Erlkönig (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A pounding, galloping triplet figure under a frightened melody. For a night chase or a haunting.

tunes.title: Der Tod und das Mädchen (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A solemn, chordal theme (Death's reply is a slow hymn-like chord progression). For death, a graveyard, a solemn choice.

tunes.title: Quartettsatz in C minor, D. 703 (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: Restless tremolo and a driving theme; an urgent chase or escape.

tunes.title: Fantaisie-Impromptu (Chopin)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A flurry of fast notes with a rolling left hand; stormy and breathless. Use for a chase. Busy: the lead will be dense.

tunes.title: Marche funèbre in C minor, K. 453a (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A slow funeral march.

tunes.title: La traviata, Preludio (Verdi)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Calcografía de la 'Nueva Biblioteca Musical Económica', 1857-1869
tunes.note: The delicate, aching string prelude. For a sad ending or a quiet menu.

tunes.title: La traviata, Brindisi, the drinking song (Verdi)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Calcografía de la 'Nueva Biblioteca Musical Económica', 1857-1869
tunes.note: The famous drinking song: a lilting waltz tune that everyone knows. Great for a party scene or a victory.

tunes.title: La traviata, Valzer e duetto (Verdi)
tunes.form: La Traviata - N3 Valzer e duetto
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Calcografía de la 'Nueva Biblioteca Musical Económica', 1857-1869
tunes.note: A waltz from the party scene.

tunes.title: La traviata, Coro di zingari, the gypsy chorus (Verdi)
tunes.form: La Traviata - N11 Coro di zingari
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Calcografía de la 'Nueva Biblioteca Musical Económica', 1857-1869
tunes.note: A rhythmic, stamping chorus with a Spanish-gypsy colour; good for a camp or a market.

tunes.title: La traviata, Coro di mattadori spagnuoli, the bullfighters (Verdi)
tunes.form: La Traviata - N12 Coro di mattadori spagnuoli
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Calcografía de la 'Nueva Biblioteca Musical Económica', 1857-1869
tunes.note: A brisk, bright Spanish fanfare; a good arena or a festival title.

tunes.title: Piano Sonata No. 17 "Tempest", 1st movement (Beethoven)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A slow, searching opening (Largo) alternating with a stormy Allegro; tense and unsettled. Good for an uneasy exploration or a cave of danger.

tunes.title: String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, 1st movement (Beethoven)
tunes.form: Quartet No. 4 in C Minor: 1. Allegro ma non tanto
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A restless, driven C minor; the top line is the first violin.

tunes.title: Toccata and Fugue in D minor (J. S. Bach, organ)
tunes.form: Toccata and Fugue in D Minor
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The famous opening: a flourish, then long chords. The very start is the "villain appears" sting; the fugue after it is a moving, restless background. Use bars 1-5 as a sting and the fugue as music.

tunes.title: Polonaise in G minor (Anna Magdalena Notebook, BWV Anh. 119)
tunes.composer: Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach (1725); composer uncertain, some pieces are by Bach's contemporaries
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A stately little polonaise in minor; light and clear.

tunes.title: Minuet in A minor (Anna Magdalena Notebook, BWV Anh. 120)
tunes.composer: Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach (1725); composer uncertain, some pieces are by Bach's contemporaries
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A light minuet in A minor.

tunes.title: March in E-flat major (Anna Magdalena Notebook, BWV Anh. 127)
tunes.composer: Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach (1725); composer uncertain, some pieces are by Bach's contemporaries
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A clear, simple march.

tunes.title: Menuet (Anna Magdalena Notebook, BWV Anh. 113)
tunes.composer: Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach (1725); composer uncertain, some pieces are by Bach's contemporaries
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A short, simple minuet; very easy to loop.

tunes.title: Dies irae, from the Requiem (Mozart)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.instrument: Voice (SATB), Orchestra: Basset Horns in F, Bassoon, Trumpet in D, Timpani, Violins, Viola, Cello, Organ/Bass
tunes.note: The "day of wrath": dark and urgent, in a choral texture (top voice as the tune). Use sparingly, as a doom or a boss sting.

tunes.title: Marche militaire No. 1 (Schubert)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: The famous military march (the first of three): a crisp, dotted rhythm and a tune everyone half-knows. Marches loop well because the phrases are square. Good for a parade, a brisk title or a "soldiers set out" scene.

tunes.title: Bourrée in E minor, BWV 996 (J. S. Bach, lute)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.publisher: Band I: J.S. Bach: Compositionen für die Laute, Denkmäler alter Lautenkunst Wolfenbüttel: Julius Zwißlers Verlag, 1921. Plate Band I. (among other sources)
tunes.note: A cheerful-but-minor dance on the lute; quick stepwise motion and a clear two-part texture that suits the lead and bass well. The minor key without gloom: a good tavern, a night market or a clever heist.

tunes.title: English Suite No. 1, Bourrée I (J. S. Bach)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A bright, steady dance with a clear tune: confident without being loud. A sturdy exploration or hub theme.

tunes.title: Gavotte (Handel)
tunes.license: Public Domain (as stated on the Mutopia Project page for this edition)
tunes.note: A neat, courtly dance with a four-square tune: simple enough for a tutorial, polite enough for a castle hall.
